maria: :megaphone: Quick update - we are opening a limited preview for a new dedicated GPU class, L5x, in two regions: Johannesburg (af-south-1) and Santiago (sa-south-1). This is targeted at customers needing mid-high throughput with lower per-token cost than current H-class pools. Docs + reservation details below.

capacity-bot: Preview pools created: L5x-JNB-pp (af-south-1) and L5x-SCL-pp (sa-south-1). Available capacity: 120 GPUs total (60 per region). Preview window: 2026-05-04T00:00Z -> 2026-06-04T00:00Z.

jonathan: Nice. Any SLA for preview?

maria: No formal SLA for the preview. Expect best-effort support and 4-hour incident response via oncall. We'll collect perf metrics and error traces for 2 weeks before deciding on GA.

sara: Is this compatible with existing Dedicated reservation flows? How do teams reserve?

maria: Yes, same reservation API but a new pool type. Reservation CLI example:

``n# reserve 4 GPUs in Johannesburg L5x preview for 30 days
rwctl reserve --pool L5x-JNB-pp --qty 4 --duration 30d --purpose "model-serving-preview"
```

akshay: What's the recommended instance sizing? i.e., common batch sizes / max seq len you tested?

maria: We optimized L5x for 8k context and steady-state throughput. Typical recommended configs: batch 4-8 for latency-sensitive, batch 32-64 for throughput. In internal tests L5x showed ~1.9x tokens/sec vs our A10-class at same power envelope for transformer decoder workloads.

rebecca: Any cost differences vs H100 or A100?

maria: Pricing for preview is discounted - we'll show preview rates in the console when you reserve. Expect GA pricing to land between A100 and H100 class economics. Also note: prefix caching and quantization profiles are enabled by default for L5x.

jonathan: Region-specific notes? power/network constraints?

maria: Johannesburg: single AZ (af-south-1a) for preview, cross-az not available. Santiago: two AZs but preview capacity primarily in sa-south-1a. Both regions have limited burst ability to the global shared pool (max 10% surge). If you need higher availability, hold off until GA when we'll add multi-AZ and dedicated redundancy.

capacity-bot: Known limitations: no preemptible pricing in preview; GPU telemetry sampling at 2s resolution; no cold-start caching for models >20B in preview.

akshay: Will Dedicated reservations migrate to GA pools automatically?

maria: No automatic migration. If you want GA-level reservations later we'll provide a migration tool and a one-click console migration path - we'll announce that timeline during the GA rollout.

sara: Who should we CC for early access approvals for customers?

maria: CC product-led-sales (pls-team) and infra-allocations for quota increases. For compliance questions include security@git.example (use the internal alias).

rebecca: Any operational runbooks published yet?

maria: Minimal runbook uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/l5x-preview-runbook (internal). We'll add full runbooks and SRE playbooks next week. If you want access, ping me.

jonathan: Noted. I'll reserve a small pool for integration tests.

maria: Thanks - please report perf regressions or strange errors in this thread or file a ticket with tag l5x-preview. We'll share an initial telemetry dashboard tomorrow. :rocket:
